create_Co3d_dataset: create a Co3d dataset instance with a ROOT path, mask_bg setting, and num_frames for multi-view 3D reconstruction training
load_scene_Co3d: load scene data from a selected_seqs JSON file filtered by scene_class or scene_id in the Co3d dataset
get_combinations_Co3d: get frame index combinations for sampling num_frames from 100 frames with min and max spacing constraints
get_views_Co3d: get multi-view image data with depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given index and resolution
sample_frames_BaseManyViewDataset: sample frames from an image pool with configurable min and max threshold spacing between consecutive frames
